text: {"assertions":["A silent drop bug in notifications/push/dispatch.py was discovered on 2026-02-21 that only manifested in deeply nested inputs beyond six levels.","The bug was reproduced by dispatching to a device token that was rotated.","The serialiser was dropping unknown fields, causing sends to report success with no actual delivery.","The silent drop bug was fixed by implementing a strict schema that rejects unknown fields (PR #2222 on branch fix/silent-drop-1).","Fixing the silent drop bug reclaimed 71 GB of blob storage.","This silent drop issue occurred in the same area of notifications/push/dispatch.py as previous silent drop work."]}
